jobs.title: Senior Director Wealth Management IT Data/AI & BOR
jobs.description:
A career as a Senior Director of Wealth Management IT – Data/AI and BOR at National Bank means acting as a leader, acceleratingtransformation. We are looking for a highly skilledand visionary individual to lead ourwealth management dataand artificial intelligence strategy by driving the delivery of critical solutions, strategic intelligenceand reporting. 
This role includes managing and modernizing the wealth BI and reporting team and ecosystems, overseeing IBOR investment registry operations (including managing tax statements and slips), and modernizing legacy platforms to meet the demands of a rapidly evolving financial services industry.
You act as a field technology leader, having technical expertise, strategic thinking, and leadership skills to transform data capabilities and operations while aligning with business objectives and regulatory standards.

Your job

Define and deploy the wealth management data and AI strategy to improve analytics, decision-making, and automation.
Ensure data governance, security, and quality, while integrating emerging technologies to support innovation and maintain a competitive advantage.
Lead the Wealth Management BI & Reporting team to provide relevant analytics that support business objectives.
Design modern BI solutions, in collaboration with architecture, enabling real-time and self-service analytics.
Define performance indicators (KPIs) and stakeholder needs, in line with the organization's priorities.
Oversee IBOR operations, including the production of customer statements and tax slips, in compliance with regulatory requirements.
Implement and maintain robust processes and technologies to ensure reliable and efficient IBOR operations.
Lead the modernization of IBOR systems to improve their reliability, scalability, and responsiveness to business and compliance needs.
Drive the modernization of data platforms and IBOR systems to cloud-based, scalable and automated solutions.
Define architecture standards with IT teams and ensure the integration of new technologies, while limiting the impact on activities through effective change management.
Lead and mobilize a high-performance IT team, promoting innovation, collaboration and continuous improvement, in partnership with business and technology teams and suppliers.
Lead the delivery of initiatives by managing budgets, timelines and resources, as well as regularly monitoring progress, risks and opportunities with senior management.

Your team

The IT and Operations sector is made up of more than 5500 experts who work in an agile, proactive and collaborative manner to seize opportunities, stay on the cutting edge of technology and continuously improve processes.

You benefit from a hybrid work model with a required presence in the office three days a week (minimum) and the option to work remotely the other two days, promoting both in-person collaboration and flexibility.
The Bank values continuous development and internal mobility. Our personalized training programs, based on learning in action, allow you to master your craft and develop new areas of expertise. Tools such as the Data Academy, language training, the Harvard Learning Center and coaching and mentoring support are available to you at all times.

Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, artificial intelligence, data science or related technology field or any other combination of education and experience deemed equivalent
10 years of relevant experience in IT leadership, with a focus on data strategy, AI and business systems management, including manager management.
Strong experience in data strategy, AI technologies and modern BI/reporting platforms (databricks, snowflake)
Experience with Investment Registry Systems and Operations (IBOR), including tax and regulatory reporting.
Experience in modernizing legacy systems and implementing cloud-based, AI-driven, and data-centric solutions.
Knowledge of data governance, regulatory compliance, and risk management in the wealth management space.
Demonstrated ability to lead and inspire cross-functional teams.
Experience in the wealth management or financial services industry is an asset. 

Languages: French, English
Reason to require this language: you will need to work closely with our colleagues outside Quebec.
Required skills: Artificial Intelligence, Business Alignment, Collaboration, Communication, Cybersecurity, Decision Making, Emotional Intelligence, Initiative, Managerial Courage, Mobilization, Problem Solving, Strategy Execution, Team Alignment, Technical Leadership, User-centered Design

Your benefits

In addition to competitive compensation, upon hiring you’ll be eligible for a wide range of flexible benefits to help promote your wellbeing and that of your family such as:

* Health and wellness program, including many options
* Flexible group insurance
* Generous pension plan
* Employee Share Ownership Plan

What You'll Do

Director, Data Architecture & Information Management

Partner with business and technology leaders to define future-state data capabilities and architecture roadmaps aligned with strategic priorities.
Define and lead the organization's Master Data Management (MDM) strategy, architecture, and roadmap, beginning with customer data and expanding across additional domains.
Own and evolve the enterprise canonical data model and business information architecture to improve consistency, interoperability, reuse, and scalability.
Establish and govern enterprise data architecture standards, design patterns, information models, reference architectures, and architecture review processes.
Lead enterprise data modeling, metadata architecture, information lifecycle management, and related architectural practices.
Evaluate emerging technologies, data platforms, and AI capabilities to strengthen the enterprise data architecture and create business value.
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of Data Architects, Data Modelers, and Data Engineers..

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Management, or a related discipline.
10+ years of progressive experience in enterprise data architecture, information architecture, data modeling, and information management.
Proven success influencing enterprise-wide business and technology decisions through architectural leadership.
Experience partnering with Enterprise, Solution, and Cloud Architects to establish end-to-end architecture strategies.
Demonstrated experience designing and implementing enterprise data standards, architecture patterns, and governance processes.
Strong expertise in conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling.
Experience leading Master Data Management (MDM) initiatives and enterprise information management programs.
Experience developing enterprise information models, integration standards, and reference architectures.
Proven ability to collaborate with senior business and technology leaders to define future-state architecture roadmaps.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in a related discipline.
Experience within financial services or another highly regulated industry.
Experience designing or supporting modern cloud-based data platforms, preferably Snowflake.
Experience with modern data transformation and modeling practices using dbt or similar technologies.
Experience enabling AI, advanced analytics, customer intelligence, and digital transformation initiatives.
Experience building and leading architecture or information management teams.

Director, Data & Information Governance

Location:
Canada – National Opportunity

Hybrid – 3 days in office

$200,000–$230,000 CAD +

About the Opportunity
Our client, a leading national law firm, is seeking a Director, Data & Information Governance to establish and lead its enterprise-wide approach to governing data, documents, records and other information assets throughout their lifecycle.
This newly created leadership position will oversee an established team, providing strategic direction and developing the operating models, policies, standards and accountabilities required to make information trusted, secure, accessible and suitable for reporting, analytics, enterprise search, digitization and artificial intelligence.
Working across Technology Services, Risk, Privacy, Information Security, Knowledge Management, Finance, Practice Groups and Business Services, the Director will translate legal, regulatory, client and business requirements into practical governance controls and measurable outcomes.

Key Responsibilities
Leadership and Strategic Vision
Establish and execute the enterprise data and information governance strategy, roadmap, investment plan and measures of success.
Lead and develop the existing data and information governance team.
Engage senior leaders and practitioners to guide organization-wide priorities and decisions.
Act as the organization's subject matter expert, providing research and decision support to executive leadership.
Partner with governance committees, practice groups and business services on implementation.
Build data literacy and adoption through communication, training and stakeholder engagement.
Establish audit and compliance practices to monitor adherence and address gaps.
Oversee the department's operating budget and resource allocation.

Data Management & Data Governance
Own the governance framework, policies and standards, including accountabilities for data owners, stewards and custodians.
Establish requirements for data quality, integrity, classification and access.
Partner with the Chief Risk Officer, IT and cybersecurity teams to manage privacy and security risks, access controls, data subject requests, breach response and backup and recovery procedures.
Partner with technology teams on scalable data architecture and infrastructure, including modelling, integration, transformation, ingestion and data warehouse performance.
Maintain common data definitions, formats and quality assurance processes.
Deliver priority data use cases with cross-functional teams, ensuring reliable preparation, testing and access for reporting and analytics.
Align data strategy and infrastructure with artificial intelligence objectives.
Oversee the curation, labelling and preparation of accurate, diverse and representative AI training datasets.
Apply privacy safeguards, including anonymization, access controls and applicable regulatory requirements such as GDPR or CCPA.
Advance AI-enabled data management, including predictive quality monitoring, automated classification and anomaly detection.
Oversee reporting, visualization and business intelligence standards, release and distribution processes, legacy report retirement and third-party analytics service levels.

Information Governance
Own information management and records policies across the matter lifecycle, from intake to final disposition, aligned with client directives, business needs and applicable laws and regulations.
Direct information classification, content placement, storage, retrieval, retention, archiving and disposal within approved repositories.
Maintain document version control and approval processes.
Apply consistent governance to client, case-related, conflicts-of-interest and financial data.
Partner with practice groups and functional owners to embed governance controls and reduce the information storage footprint.

Key Outcomes and Accountabilities
Clear ownership and adoption:
Establish accountability among data owners, stewards and custodians while monitoring policy adoption, compliance and data literacy.
Trusted, accessible data:
Ensure reporting and analytics teams have timely, authorized access to accurate, complete and consistently defined data.
Protected information:
Ensure sensitive and confidential information is appropriately classified, protected and restricted to authorized users.
Effective information lifecycle:
Ensure information is retrievable, version-controlled and managed in accordance with retention, archiving and disposal requirements.
Reliable, scalable data services:
Ensure data integration, ingestion, warehouse performance and processing capabilities support business needs and continued digitization.
Actionable business insights:
Oversee reports, dashboards, scorecards, KPIs, projections and predictive analytics that meet stakeholder needs.
Business and AI enablement:
Ensure priority business and AI use cases deliver measurable results supported by reliable data, infrastructure, security and privacy safeguards.

Qualifications and Experience
Ideally, 10+ years of relevant leadership and business experience in data management, analytics, customer insights and strategic transformation.
Demonstrated experience across both enterprise data governance and information/records management.
Significant experience in enterprise data architecture, security, upstream and downstream data workflows, systems and business processes.
Domain expertise in data management, data governance, reporting and analytics.
Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate and develop high-performing teams.
Strong financial management skills and understanding of the financial aspects of business operations.
Strong business acumen and analytical capabilities.
Independent thought leadership and the ability to navigate the complexities of executing enterprise-wide strategies.
Ability to influence senior executives and stakeholders without direct reporting relationships.
Strong organizational awareness, communication and stakeholder management skills.
Graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Commerce or a related discipline.
An MBA or relevant education in Business, Commerce, Data Analytics or Data Engineering would be considered an asset.

Preferred Experience
Experience working within a large national or international law firm is strongly preferred.
Experience within a complex enterprise environment of approximately 800 employees or more.
Experience at the Manager, Senior Manager or Director level.
Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, SQL and Power BI.
Experience developing and implementing enterprise governance strategies, policies and operating models.
Experience managing departmental budgets and strategic investments.

Working closely with other Digital specialists, Project Controls and Program Management teams, you will align business processes, systems, data and information across project mobilization, delivery and operational readiness. Lead client relationships, strategic pursuits and proposals, translating client needs into delivery approaches, resource plans and commercial proposals.

Develop service offerings, standards, methodologies and reusable delivery assets aligned with client needs and the E&NR Digital strategy.

Client Delivery and Technical Assurance

Lead the design and implementation of target operating models, governance frameworks and digital transformation initiatives.

Lead enterprise architecture, solution design and implementation activities, aligning business capabilities, applications, data and integration requirements with client enterprise standards.

Oversee business analysis, requirements management, process engineering, change management, and organizational readiness activities.

Lead the implementation, integration and optimization of Project Management Information Systems (PMIS), Common Data Environments (CDEs), Project Controls solutions and associated digital workflows.

Oversee testing, user acceptance, deployment readiness, and transition to ongoing support.

Manage engagement scope, resources, delivery risks and client satisfaction, acting as the senior escalation point for complex stakeholder matters and strategic project decisions.

People Leadership

Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment that promotes knowledge sharing, innovation and continuous improvement.

Coordinate specialist resources across Digital and related capability areas to support successful client outcomes.

Build and develop the Business Systems & Integration capability through coaching, mentoring and development initiatives.

Support workforce planning, recruitment, performance management, and succession planning across the Digital team.

Qualifications

Essential

Degree in Business / Project Management, Information Management / Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

15+ years of experience supporting Energy & Natural Resources capital projects across project delivery, project controls and related digital disciplines, with a strong understanding of owner, EPCM and contractor delivery models throughout the project lifecycle.

Excellent leadership, stakeholder engagement and communication skills, including the ability to advise senior client stakeholders.

Proven experience developing client relationships, shaping proposals and winning or expanding consulting engagements.

Experience managing engagement scope, resources, budgets, delivery risks and commercial performance.

Experience leading and developing multidisciplinary teams, including recruitment, coaching, capability development and performance management.

Experience developing enterprise architecture, target operating models, governance frameworks and digital / business transformation strategies.

Experience leading software implementation and integration, data and information modelling, business analysis, process engineering and organizational change initiatives.

Experience leading the implementation, integration or governance of Project Management Information Systems (PMIS), Common Data Environments (CDEs) and Project Controls solutions.

Desirable

Experience leading enterprise-wide digital transformation initiatives across complex capital project portfolios, including the integration of Project Controls, Information Management and Data & Analytics solutions.

Depth in relevant Project Management Information Systems (PMIS) and Project Controls platforms, with experience leading implementations and integrations involving solutions such as Procore, Aconex, Omega 365, InEight, Autodesk Construction Cloud, EcoSys, Contruent, Unifier, OPC, Primavera P6, Hexagon SDx or similar solutions.

At Range Group
we believe in the power of the professional travel advisor. We represent over $4.5 billion in annual travel sales. All our investments stem from a common thesis, that travel advisors add real value to a trip. Travel advisors when equipped with technology and 24/7 support are irreplaceable. Equally important is our philanthropy. Range Foundation channels 10% of group profits to social impact. From exploration grants, improved access to education, new discoveries on sea and land, cultural infrastructure, and helping our global neighbors in times of need — we are investing to build a better future.

About The Role

This is a hands-on senior finance leadership role for someone who operates at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and execution. You’re as comfortable building a complex multi-entity model from scratch as you are presenting the story behind the numbers to the executive team.

As Director, FP&A, you will own the analytical engine that supports decision-making across Range Group’s portfolio of travel brands — leading enterprise planning and forecasting, managing a small team, and working directly with senior leadership to evaluate opportunities, navigate risks, and drive performance.

What You’ll Do

Financial Modelling & Planning

Build, maintain, and continuously improve financial models covering consolidated Group performance, brand-level P&Ls, cash flow forecasting, and scenario analysis.
Own the Group-level cash flow tracker and EBITDA bridging model, ensuring accuracy and timeliness week over week.
Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes across the organization.
Support ad hoc financial analysis — acquisition modelling, business case development, and covenant compliance.
Drive continuous improvement in financial planning frameworks, forecasting methodologies, and analytical tools.

Performance Management & Executive Insights

Own enterprise-wide performance reporting — financial reviews, KPI dashboards, executive scorecards, and variance commentary.
Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews with senior leadership.
Translate financial results into clear, decision-ready insights that prompt action.
Identify and proactively flag emerging risks, opportunities, and performance trends across the portfolio.

Strategic Business Partnership

Partner with executive and business leaders to align financial plans with strategic priorities and growth objectives.
Evaluate investments, business initiatives, and strategic opportunities through modelling and scenario analysis.
Provide financial leadership on strategic initiatives, business cases, and investment decisions.
Support executive and Board reporting requirements.

Treasury & Foreign Exchange Management

Own foreign exchange exposure tracking, reporting, and scenario analysis across the Group's multi-currency operations.
Partner with treasury, banking partners, and external advisors to evaluate foreign exchange risks and mitigation strategies.
Assess the financial impact of currency fluctuations on forecasts, budgets, cash flow, and business performance.
Develop recommendations and decision-support materials for leadership regarding FX risk management and capital planning.
Monitor market trends and currency movements, proactively identifying risks and opportunities that may impact business performance.

Team Leadership & Capability Building

Lead a small finance team — including a Finance Manager and intern — as a player-coach: owning models and analysis end-to-end while delegating and developing where appropriate.
Foster a high-performance, analytically rigorous culture within the team.
Support ERP and reporting tool improvements from a finance data and output perspective.
Champion the evolution of finance from a reporting function to a true strategic business partner.

What You’ll Bring

8+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, Corporate Finance, Strategic Finance, or Finance Business Partnering — with a track record of owning complex models in a multi-entity environment.
Advanced Excel skills — non-negotiable. You build models from scratch, structure them for auditability, and are fast and precise in the tool.
Strong accounting foundation: you understand how the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement connect inside a model.
Proven experience leading enterprise budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes.
Experience analyzing foreign exchange exposure, multi-currency financial impacts, and scenario modelling within a corporate FP&A, finance, or strategic finance environment.
Strong executive presence, comfortable presenting to senior leadership and capable of influencing and constructively challenging stakeholders.
Experience in multi-entity and multi-currency operating environments.
CPA designation strongly preferred; candidates without the designation will be considered where technical skills and experience are strong.
Background in travel, technology, hospitality, or another fast-paced, multi-brand environment is an asset.

Who You Are

You are a builder. You prefer to own models end-to-end and take pride in work that is structured, auditable, and built to last.
You are intellectually curious and detail-oriented, but able to zoom out and connect the numbers to a broader business narrative.
You operate well with ambiguity and can manage competing priorities without losing accuracy or composure.
You are a collaborative leader who still wants to be close to the work — energized by doing, not just directing.
You communicate with a low-ego, peer-level style — credible with senior stakeholders, collegial with the broader team, and proactive about surfacing issues.

This is a rare opportunity to bridge corporate finance and executive strategy in a multi-brand travel and technology portfolio. You’ll have genuine influence — shaping how capital is allocated, how performance is communicated, and how the finance function evolves as the company grows.

The role carries real complexity: multi-entity consolidations, multi-currency exposure, and a direct reporting line to the Chief Finance Officer. You’ll lead a small team and have the space to build the frameworks and processes that become the foundation for the company’s next phase.

The Occupational Health and Safety Prevention Services Branch leads Alberta’s OHS system to enable and support prevention of occupational illness, injury and fatalities through promotion of workplace health and safety culture and evaluation of effectiveness of the overall system.

OHS Strategic Evidence and Action (SEA) Unit

Management of team resources and promoting inter-team communication and collaboration to achieve program objectives.

jobs.title: Head of User Acquisition
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

BET99 is a Canadian online sportsbook and casino with a bigger ambition: to build a connected world of sports, gaming and entertainment that people choose to be part of. We believe the best moments are shared, and we are building a business that brings people together around the things they love.

At the centre of that vision are the 99ers: a community built on shared interests, experiences and a sense of belonging. Through BET99 and Ninety9 Entertainment, our vision connects digital products with content, creators, live events, hospitality, tournaments and merchandise. Each creates another reason to discover us, participate and come back. Community participation extends beyond gaming, with experiences that have value in their own right.

We’re a fast-paced company and are looking for individuals who live and breathe our core values: challenging the status quo, trust, transparency, integrity, and collaboration.
Joining BET99 means helping shape what comes next—with the opportunity to build, make decisions and see your work directly influence our growth.

The Opportunity:

Help shape how BET99 wins its next generation of customers. User acquisition is central to our ambition: this role will determine where we invest, how effectively we convert interest into customers, and whether that growth creates lasting commercial value.

You will lead our digital and affiliate acquisition and growth strategy, bringing commercial judgment, analytical depth and the ability to turn strategy into execution. The opportunity is to build a repeatable growth engine: one that understands customer quality, finds incremental demand and scales investment with confidence.

The work will be visible to senior leadership and closely connected to company performance. You will help shape the team, operating practices and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth, with the CMO as your direct partner.

Your Mandate:

Deliver sustainable, profitable new-customer growth by connecting acquisition strategy, media investment, creative, conversion and measurement. Translate company objectives into an actionable growth plan, and make clear recommendations about where to scale, test, improve or stop spending by first establishing a reliable, verified data baseline.

Success means acquiring customers who generate lasting value, understanding the economics behind that growth, and building a team that can repeat and improve the results. Player protection, regulatory compliance and brand trust must remain embedded in how we grow.

What you will Own:

Growth strategy and investment. Build the annual acquisition plan, channel forecasts and investment recommendations. Manage approved budgets, explain performance against plan and recommend reallocations based on marginal returns, customer quality and payback.
Channel performance. Lead paid search, paid social, programmatic, app acquisition and emerging digital channels. Align affiliate acquisition with the broader growth plan in partnership with the Affiliate team, with clear ownership and consistent measurement across channels.
Customer conversion. Partner with Product, Technology, Data and CRM to identify and remove friction from landing pages through registration, verification and first deposit. Prioritize improvements by expected value and validate the effect on conversion and customer quality.
Measurement and commercial insight. Establish a shared view of acquisition performance with Finance and Data by auditing and fixing the underlying MarTech tracking tools (eg. app tracking and server pixels) to accurately measure CAC, cohort value, contribution and payback. Improve attribution, tracking and incrementality testing so investment decisions reflect additional business generated, with appropriate recognition of uncertainty.
Experimentation and discovery. Build a disciplined testing program across audiences, creative, bidding, channels and customer journeys. Partner with Brand, Creative and Content on effective acquisition assets and search visibility. Evaluate SEO, AI-powered discovery and automation against clear hypotheses and demonstrated value.
People and operating discipline. Lead and develop the acquisition team, set clear accountabilities and hold agencies and partners to agreed standards. Establish a regular performance and learning cadence, escalate constraints early and ensure acquisition activity meets advertising and responsible gambling requirements.

What Success Looks Like:

Your first-year priorities will be agreed with the CMO and relevant functional leaders, using verified baselines and approved resources. We will assess success against the following outcomes.

Profitable growth. Deliver the agreed new-customer and commercial contribution plan within approved investment and payback parameters, with customer quality assessed beyond the first deposit.
Confident investment decisions. Establish a trusted view of channel and cohort economics, fix critical tracking and measurement gaps, and use evidence to distinguish incremental growth from demand that would have converted anyway.
A stronger acquisition journey. Deliver prioritized conversion improvements with Product and Technology, demonstrating their effect on completed onboarding and first deposits while maintaining required checks.
A repeatable source of improvement. Run a documented testing program that produces actionable learning, scales effective approaches and stops weak investments quickly.
A capable and accountable team. Establish clear ownership, coaching and partner expectations, supported by forecasts and reporting that help leadership make timely decisions.

Your First Months:

First 30 Days:
Complete a comprehensive review of acquisition channels, agency and affiliate relationships, technology platforms, and current operating processes
Validate acquisition reporting and identify key measurement, attribution, and tracking gaps impacting decision-making
Build relationships with key stakeholders across Creative, Marketing Ops, Partnerships, Product, Tech and BI to understand opportunities, constraints, and priorities
Deliver an initial assessment outlining immediate opportunities, risks, and recommendations for next steps

First 90 Days:
Present a comprehensive acquisition strategy, channel investment framework, and testing roadmap aligned to company growth objectives.
Put together a product roadmap and begin implementing the highest priority items with Tech
Establish and launch testing roadmap focusing on different channels, audiences, creative, bidding strategies, and conversion journeys
Identify and evaluation current and potential partners, tools and resources to optimize our acquisition and retention strategies

By 6 Months:
Implement net new tracking, attribution, and measurement improvements that increase confidence in acquisition reporting and investment decisions.
Generate a lift in installs, registrations and lifetime value while reducing our cost per install and acquisition across each digital channel and partner
Establish a roadmap, calendar and workback schedule for the remainder of 2027 and Q1-2028 highlighting key campaigns, testing schedule, media block
Present optimized department org chart, roles and responsibilities to establish an effective and efficient team

What you Bring:

A record of growing a consumer business through digital and affiliate acquisition, with evidence of improved customer economics as investment scales. You can explain what you personally owned, the decisions you made and the results that followed.
Hands-on MarTech & Tracking Experience: Direct experience fixing and setting up marketing technology tools, mobile app tracking (eg. AppsFlyer or Adjust), and server-side tracking pixels to eliminate missing data by working directly with our Tech and Data Engineering teams.
Experience leading teams and managing substantial media and affiliate investment across multiple channels. You can move between strategy, forecasts and hands-on performance diagnosis, and challenge agency or platform recommendations constructively.
Experience evaluating and scaling affiliate acquisition programs. You understand how to assess partner quality, customer value, incremental contribution and long-term commercial impact, and can make informed recommendations on where to invest, expand, renegotiate or reduce spend.
Strong commercial and analytical judgment across CAC, lifetime value, contribution, retention and payback. You understand the limitations of platform ROAS and attribution, and have used experiments or other credible methods to test incrementality.
Practical experience improving web or app acquisition funnels and partnering with creative, product, technical and data specialists to turn insight into shipped improvements.
The ability to build clear plans, develop people and secure decisions across teams with competing priorities. You make tradeoffs explicit and communicate both results and uncertainty clearly.
A thoughtful approach to AI and automation, including examples of where they improved execution or decision-making. You can assess emerging discovery channels without confusing activity with commercial impact.
Direct experience in online sportsbook, casino, fantasy sports, gaming, or another highly regulated digital consumer industry. You understand the unique acquisition, attribution, compliance, and player-value dynamics that influence sustainable growth in these markets.

Experience in regulated gaming or another regulated consumer business is valuable. You must be able to build a strong understanding of our markets and exercise sound judgment around advertising, customer eligibility and player protection. We welcome relevant achievements from different career paths; demonstrated scope and results matter more than a particular title.

How you will work:

You will bring deep technical expertise in digital acquisition and the willingness to roll up your sleeves. That means getting into advertising platforms, interrogating tracking and attribution, diagnosing funnel issues and working alongside the team to improve performance. You must be able to connect the technical details to the commercial decisions they inform.

You will also be a strong manager and leader: setting direction, making priorities clear, coaching your team and holding people accountable. You will know when to get directly involved and when to give others the ownership and support to deliver.

Collaboration is essential. You will work closely with Brand, Creative, Product, Technology, Data, Finance, Affiliates and CRM to turn opportunities into results. You will bring clear recommendations, listen to other perspectives and resolve tradeoffs constructively. Success requires both leading your own team effectively and building productive relationships across the business.

Why Join BET99:

At BET99, you get the scale and ambition of a major business with the access, energy and entrepreneurial spirit of a much smaller company. You can know the people making the decisions, challenge how things are done and see your ideas become part of what we build.

We approach our work like a high-performing sports team. We set ambitious goals, hold ourselves accountable and back each other to succeed. We want people who raise the standard, challenge the status quo and get excited about building something uniquely ours.

For this role, that means a commercially significant mandate, direct partnership with the CMO and the opportunity to shape how a Canadian sports, gaming and entertainment business grows. Your expertise will influence real investment decisions, and your leadership will help build the team behind the results.

jobs.description:
We are seeking a senior technical leader specializing in building high-performance, interactive data visualization platforms and enterprise reporting engines. This is an expert-level role focused on creating advanced, web-based analytical applications that combine rich, interactive frontends with highly optimized, data-intensive backends and distributed query engines. A mandatory and critical secondary focus of this role is the design and creation of custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools. You will build the bridge between LLMs/AI agents and our enterprise data layers, including Starburst, enabling AI to autonomously and securely query, analyze, and report on massive datasets.

Core Responsibilities

You will own the end-to-end design and delivery of sophisticated FinTech tools used directly by investment bankers, front-office traders, and financial analysts. This requires translating complex financial workflows into intuitive, high-fidelity web interfaces. Your primary focus will be on architecting and building highly interactive, web-based analytical dashboards using Angular and React, allowing users to slice, dice, and explore massive datasets in real-time.

A key function is leveraging Starburst (Trino) to query massive, distributed datasets with sub-second latency. You will design and implement robust backend microservices (Java/Spring Boot) optimized for low-latency data retrieval, heavy aggregation, and streaming large datasets to the frontend. Furthermore, you will be responsible for designing and optimizing scalable ETL processes to manage huge volumes of financial data.

A mandatory responsibility is to design, build, and maintain custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and tools. This enables AI agents and LLMs to securely interface with internal databases, APIs, and reporting engines. You will also architect enterprise-grade document generation engines using the Aspose suite to programmatically create high-fidelity financial reports from complex templates.

As a hands-on player/coach, you will deliver complex data visualizations and reporting engines while mentoring junior engineers. This includes critically reviewing and taking ownership of all AI-generated code (Java, Angular, React, SQL) to ensure structural integrity, security compliance, and production readiness, while applying a deep functional understanding of Corporate and Investment Banking (CIB) to all projects.

Key Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience:

Systems Fundamentals: Strong foundation in systems analysis, design patterns, data analysis, and the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), including unit testing and CI/CD practices.
Backend Development: Extensive hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot for building scalable, low-latency microservices and reactive data streaming APIs.
Frontend & Visualization: Strong, hands-on experience with Angular 19+, React, TypeScript, HTML5, and Web Sockets for building interactive, data-intensive dashboards.
Data Federation & Querying: Hands-on experience with Starburst (Trino) for querying massive, distributed datasets across federated enterprise data sources.
Databases & Data Modeling: Deep experience with relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server) and NoSQL (MongoDB), including physical/logical database design, data modeling, and performance tuning.
ETL & Data Processing: Proven experience designing high-throughput ETL pipelines and optimizing data flows for real-time reporting.
Enterprise Reporting: Experience building document generation engines using the Aspose suite (Aspose.Words, Aspose.Cells, Aspose.PDF).
MCP Tool Creation: Demonstrated ability to design and build custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to securely connect LLMs and AI agents to enterprise data.
AI-Assisted Engineering: Hands-on proficiency with AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) and the ability to write structured prompts and engineer high-quality context (schemas, API specs) for AI agents.
Collaboration Tools: Strong experience with GitHub for source control and Jira for project management.

Preferred Skills & Experience:

8+ years of relevant experience
Experience designing and implementing agentic AI workflows and integrating AI agents directly into CI/CD pipelines.
A strong understanding of event-driven systems and real-time message streaming platforms like Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ.

Domain

Functional understanding of Banking — able to articulate why their work matters, not just how it is built.

This is not a conventional engineering role. You are expected to operate as a force multiplier — directing AI agents across multiple workstreams, validating output for production safety, and coaching others to do the same. The measure of success is not lines of code written, but outcomes delivered, quality maintained, and the team's collective capability raised.

Plus de 12 ans d'expérience progressive en comptabilité, dont au moins 4 ans à un poste de direction.

Help shape how BET99 wins its next generation of customers. User acquisition is central to our ambition: this role will determine where we invest, how effectively we convert interest into customers, and whether that growth creates lasting commercial value.

You will lead our digital and affiliate acquisition and growth strategy, bringing commercial judgment, analytical depth and the ability to turn strategy into execution. The work will be visible to senior leadership and closely connected to company performance. You will help shape the team, operating practices and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth, with the CMO as your direct partner.

Your Mandate:

Deliver sustainable, profitable new-customer growth by connecting acquisition strategy, media investment, creative, conversion and measurement. Translate company objectives into an actionable growth plan, and make clear recommendations about where to scale, test, improve or stop spending by first establishing a reliable, verified data baseline.

Success means acquiring customers who generate lasting value, understanding the economics behind that growth, and building a team that can repeat and improve the results. Player protection, regulatory compliance and brand trust must remain embedded in how we grow.

What you will Own:

Growth strategy and investment. Build the annual acquisition plan, channel forecasts and investment recommendations. Manage approved budgets, explain performance against plan and recommend reallocations based on marginal returns, customer quality and payback.
Channel performance. Lead paid search, paid social, programmatic, app acquisition and emerging digital channels. Align affiliate acquisition with the broader growth plan in partnership with the Affiliate team, with clear ownership and consistent measurement across channels.
Customer conversion. Partner with Product, Technology, Data and CRM to identify and remove friction from landing pages through registration, verification and first deposit. Prioritize improvements by expected value and validate the effect on conversion and customer quality.
Measurement and commercial insight. Establish a shared view of acquisition performance with Finance and Data by auditing and fixing the underlying MarTech tracking tools (eg. app tracking and server pixels) to accurately measure CAC, cohort value, contribution and payback. Improve attribution, tracking and incrementality testing so investment decisions reflect additional business generated, with appropriate recognition of uncertainty.
Experimentation and discovery. Build a disciplined testing program across audiences, creative, bidding, channels and customer journeys. Partner with Brand, Creative and Content on effective acquisition assets and search visibility. Evaluate SEO, AI-powered discovery and automation against clear hypotheses and demonstrated value.
People and operating discipline. Lead and develop the acquisition team, set clear accountabilities and hold agencies and partners to agreed standards. Establish a regular performance and learning cadence, escalate constraints early and ensure acquisition activity meets advertising and responsible gambling requirements.

What Success Looks Like:

Your first-year priorities will be agreed with the CMO and relevant functional leaders, using verified baselines and approved resources. We will assess success against the following outcomes.

Profitable growth. Deliver the agreed new-customer and commercial contribution plan within approved investment and payback parameters, with customer quality assessed beyond the first deposit.
Confident investment decisions. Establish a trusted view of channel and cohort economics, fix critical tracking and measurement gaps, and use evidence to distinguish incremental growth from demand that would have converted anyway.
A stronger acquisition journey. Deliver prioritized conversion improvements with Product and Technology, demonstrating their effect on completed onboarding and first deposits while maintaining required checks.
A repeatable source of improvement. Run a documented testing program that produces actionable learning, scales effective approaches and stops weak investments quickly.
A capable and accountable team. Establish clear ownership, coaching and partner expectations, supported by forecasts and reporting that help leadership make timely decisions.

First 30 Days:
Complete a comprehensive review of acquisition channels, agency and affiliate relationships, technology platforms, and current operating processes

Build relationships with key stakeholders across Creative, Marketing Ops, Partnerships, Product, Tech and BI to understand opportunities, constraints, and priorities
Deliver an initial assessment outlining immediate opportunities, risks, and recommendations for next steps

First 90 Days:
Present a comprehensive acquisition strategy, channel investment framework, and testing roadmap aligned to company growth objectives.
Put together a product roadmap and begin implementing the highest priority items with Tech
Establish and launch testing roadmap focusing on different channels, audiences, creative, bidding strategies, and conversion journeys
Identify and evaluation current and potential partners, tools and resources to optimize our acquisition and retention strategies

By 6 Months:

As a hands-on player/coach, you will deliver complex data visualizations and reporting engines while mentoring junior engineers. This role manages two key development verticals: Business development and project development.

Your role will encompass:

Responsible for growing the renewables portfolio in North America (focus on Canada) via acquisition/greenfielding and progressing development activities through to construction.
Accountable for managing, leading, and supervising managers and analysts of the two segmeneted Development teams; Business Development (M&A, partnerships, financial modeling) and Project Development (greenfielding, site control, permitting, environmental studies, interconnection, stakeholder relations, and regulatory matters).
Originate acquisition opportunities in North American markets by developing and cultivating relationships with bankers, advisors, developers, and key stakeholders and inform the Country Manager (Canada) of new opportunities, market insights and trends
Lead transaction processes from origination through execution and handoffs: bid submissions, deal structuring, valuation, coordinating due-diligence with internal SMEs, financing, and executing definitive documents.
Prepare pitch books / investment memoranda and presenting the transaction’s investment thesis/rationale to the Country Manager (Canada), the Regional Managing Director – North America, and Metlen's internal investment and risk committees ensuring clear communication of risks, opportunities, and strategic alignment.
Develop and execute North American (focus on Canada) greenfield strategy to grow renewables project pipeline.
Ensure projects pipeline continues advancement of preconstruction activities on schedule, within budget, and with risks routinely identified and mitigated.

Minimum of 10 years in the power industry (preferably renewables) with experience in a similar senior management capacity overseeing project development and acquisition/investment activities

Extensive knowledge of North American renewable energy markets and utility-scale solar/wind/BESS project development including permitting, environmental, interconnection, regulatory, and stakeholder management.
